description: Use when an agent, x402 test or CI job needs Base Sepolia gas now: one x402 call, no faucet login or mainnet history. Input: to (recipient address); sends 0.1 ETH (1 ETH: /v1/testnet/base-sepolia-eth/1). Output: JSON txHash (confirmed before settling), explorerUrl, amountEth, from, to. Daily limits (UTC): 5 ETH per address (both sizes), 20 overall; checked before payment. Test ETH has no monetary value. Example: ?to=0x000000000000000000000000000000000000dEaD Price: $0.05 USDC (Base or Solana) via x402.

to.description: Recipient address (EIP-55 checksum if mixed case). Bad input, caps reached or out of stock → 4xx/503 before payment (not charged)
